text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Right, I think I'll get the zaru soba again today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Edo girls eat with class. A quick dip in the sauce and it's down the hatch. Just like this!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whazzat?! My nose is… ah, ah… ah, ACHOO!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Argh! I drenched the entire plate!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now I won't be able to taste the soba at all! What a waste!
